name: Old Lottery Ticket
desc: A worthless ticket from the Lower Levels Lottery. No winning numbers, just faded hope.

name: Attachable Extended Barrel
desc: A multi-caliber extended barrel that improve bullet velocity and accuracy.

name: MBS Nerve Gas
desc: A highly toxic chemical weapon designed to disrupt the nervous system. Symptoms include: Respiratory failure, Convulsions, Loss of bodily functions, Unconsciousness and Death.

name: Codeword List
desc: An inconspicuous slip of paper with a hastily written key for the code used by revolutionaries.

name: Disposable Keycard (Research)
desc: A single-use keycard for Research and Development. Can open locks that require Science Department access.

name: Blank Module
desc: A blank module. With the right machine, this could rewrite this into something useful.

name: Node (Small)
desc: A specialized circuit that can provide or receive bonuses from adjacent Modules when installed in certain Machines.
